reason: The picture shows resident microbes among the fibre in the wet food remainder, matching the remaining goal.
expectation: The microbes will turn some of the fibre into smaller molecules.

effect: The microbes turned some fibre into small fatty acids and gas, completing the remaining goal. Some fibre and the bacteria remained.
reaction: The gas was an unexpected product; the result also connected back to the molecules the colon lining can take in.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the inner wall was most worthwhile: it showed how the lining separates the contents from blood while recovering water and taking in some bacterial products.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding mucus was clear but fairly predictable; it did not add much explanation by itself.

surprise.text: I was surprised that gut bacteria produce gas as well as small fatty acids from some fibre.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary: the pictures and goals made the pairings clear.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter because connecting the wall's water recovery with what bacteria make was interesting, though the assembly steps themselves were predictable.
